fields.description: Matches the schema's function.name — the same string the model calls and that shows up in Agent Definition's allowed_tools.
fields.label: Tool Name

fields.description: Disabled tools are dropped from every agent's tool schema regardless of that agent's own allow/block list. This only hides the tool from the model — it is not an execution-time permission boundary (see ToolExecutor).
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Synced from the tool's schema.py description. Edit schema.py to change this, not this field directly — it will be overwritten on the next sync.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: True if this tool is no longer registered as of the last sync (its py/schema file was removed or renamed). Kept, not deleted, so you can decide whether to clean it up.
fields.label: Orphaned
